note: golive-final: the single go-live run (Rodney: all Mono work first, one go-live test), NOT RUN. Order = cheapest decisive gate first: smoke (Dry, switch read-back) -> G7 dry apply (BP, IP, SV, crowd, build/buy + Edit Town, venue hour, second runs) -> acting (smoke, BP, IP, crowd, saves, pets, interrupts, second runs) -> crowd cost guard on/off (both orders) -> G8 seeded behaviour pairs (BP, IP, 2 x 30 min) -> G9b save + reload during acting (SV, BP, IP, 2 runs each). Gate stops (by hand, queue.ts does not stop on a FAIL row): any G7 row FAIL = stop before bp-gf-act-smoke (docs/124 §14.4 S3 stop rule: widen TopN/Margin once); act smoke FAIL = stop; G8 FAIL = exclude the definition, rerun the G8 pair (--only); resume with --from <id>. golive-ab.json stays a separate timing queue (clean night, ABBA). PLACEHOLDERS: asi game-copy/ts3native.asi.golive-final and package game-copy/ts3fixes.package.golive-final are filled by the build round (ts3native with docs/124 §17.10 Config keys 24-30 + docs/206 Satb act; ts3fixes = node tools/setup/build-fixes.ts --on kAutLive, ApplyTuned + autliveguard). Every job: Mode=3 Satb=2 WindowWaitUs 0, TopN 10, Bands 3, Margin 0, MaxWait 3, VerifyEvery 50, [MonoThread] LazyGate/LazyEarly 1 (golive-g7/act ini); Dry 1 only in G7 jobs; guard jobs Audit 0 DumpOnMismatch 0 (golive-guard ini). Read-back: logRequire on the ts3native go-live line (exact TopN/Bands/Margin/MaxWait/VerifyEvery/Dry) and the Satb line; queue.ts fails a job on a "tuned: ... MISSING" ts3fixes line and on shadow jobs without cuts. noSamplers on every job (no heavy tool, so the declared smoke can gate the run). Reports: node tools/harness/mono-cost-report.ts <queue jsonl> ("go-live", "go-live objects", "G7 dry apply", "go-live cost guard"); records autshadow.jsonl dry-diff / live-drop / live-guard. Estimated game time ~9.5 h (447 profile minutes + ~4 min load/close per job, 30 jobs + smoke). Crash rule: stop the queue by hand at the first crash (queue.ts itself stops only on the same job twice or two crashed jobs in a row; night chains go on), triage with node tools/harness/crash-ledger.ts triage and the [Crash] Log lines before any rerun; two clean runs per world before a gate verdict.
